card.name: Linking word before combination-regimen drug names
card.fires_on: The word "with" (also a comma or plus sign) right after "in combination" or a drug name, just before a list of partner drugs in oncology regimens, especially multiple myeloma.

modes.label: In combination with
modes.description: "with" after "in combination" introducing partner drugs such as bortezomib or pomalidomide.

modes.label: Comma or plus in regimen lists
modes.description: A comma or plus sign between drug names in a named regimen.
modes.example: Kyprolis and Dexamethasone OR Kyprolis, Daratumumab, and Dexamethasone OR Kyprolis<<,>> Isatuximab, and D

card.plain: It marks the spot where a drug name is joined to its partner drugs in a combination regimen.
